newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Molecular Dynamics upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Molecular Dynamics upgraded.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist LLC said it upgraded Molecular Dynamics Inc to strong buy from buy.
-- cited Molecular Dynamics's announcement that its DNA sequencer will be evaluated by Incyte Pharmaceuticals before commercial launch.
-- said Incyte's evaluation and final modifications will make the MegaBACE 1000 product commerically available in late summer.
-- said the rapidly-growing DNA sequencing market, estimated to be $500 million worldwide, is an enormous opportunity for Molecular Dynamics.
-- expects Molecular Dynamics to earn $0.45 a share in fiscal 1997 and $0.57 in fiscal 1998.
